$comment: A ferrite_bead (rDc 33 ohm) in series with 47 kohm into 1 uF from a source stepping 5, 2, 8 V over three 100.5 ms phases: tau = (47 kohm + 33 ohm) x 1 uF = 47 ms, exact exponentials toward each level. Well under the bead's saturation current, so it stays a resistor.

The edits land at 100.5 ms and 201 ms, inside a classic step and not on a sample, so a stepped classic is judged by the comparison's Richardson rule; the core is within W0 of the closed form at every sample (P0-SG verifier V1).
